title: Vintage 1975 Playboy Playmate Desk Calendar Easel Stand Original Envelope
condition_description: Only the January 1975 page is included; the other eleven months are not present. Easel stand clean and sturdy with its fold-out back intact. Original envelope has scuffs, glue spots and edge wear. See photos.
description:
Vintage 1975 Playboy Playmate desk calendar, (c) 1974 Playboy, in the original black and cream easel stand stamped "Playboy Playmate Calendar", with the original green gift mailing envelope ($1.25 cover price).

PLEASE NOTE: only the JANUARY 1975 page (Martha Smith) is included. The other eleven months are not present.

The easel stand is clean with its fold-out back intact. The envelope shows scuffs, glue spots and edge wear - see photos.

Adult collectible - sold to buyers 18+ only. Ships in a plain, protective mailer.
